_comment: groundTruth: authored from docs/dev/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-22 (launchers offer and stop only labelled sessions). A running container is a TI-Toolbox session when its service is tit (tit.service, else com.docker.compose.service; empty or absent counts as tit) and it carries tit.stack=ti-toolbox-v3, a non-empty tit.project or a non-empty tit.host_project_dir. No released launcher ever stamped another tit.stack value. Read by tests/test_launch_contract.py (tit.launch, loader.sh) and desktop/tests/unit/launch-contract.test.ts (isToolboxContainer).
